# RealHunt

> RealHunt lists cheap homes for sale around the world (mostly under €100,000), each checked by a person and graded from 70 to 98 against every other home on the site. It is not an estate agent: every home links to its original listing.

Today: 634 homes in 19 countries. Updated 2026-11-20.

## Key pages

- [Best homes](https://realhunt.co/): all homes, best score first, with filters.
- [How the score works](https://realhunt.co/method): the 11 sub-scores and what the grade means.
- [New homes](https://realhunt.co/new) and [RSS](https://realhunt.co/feed.xml)
- [Prices by country](https://realhunt.co/research/prices): median price and price per m² by country.
- [Buying costs abroad](https://realhunt.co/costs)
- [Buying guides by country](https://realhunt.co/guide)
- [Can I buy there? Rules by nationality](https://realhunt.co/can-i-buy)
- [Buying-cost calculator](https://realhunt.co/buying-costs)
- [Compare two countries](https://realhunt.co/countries)
- [New builds Top 100](https://realhunt.co/top): Bali, Phuket, Tulum, Batumi, Koh Samui.
- [Research and guides](https://realhunt.co/blog) and [RSS](https://realhunt.co/blog/rss.xml)
- [Site map](https://realhunt.co/sitemap)
- [Full reference text](https://realhunt.co/llms-full.txt): method, costs, guides and every home in one file.

- [Buying costs by country: taxes and fees on top of the price (2026)](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country.csv)

## Files for machines (no account, no key)

- [OpenAPI description of every file](https://realhunt.co/openapi.json)
- [Countries: key figures and the address of each country file](https://realhunt.co/data/countries/index.json)
- Per country: https://realhunt.co/data/countries/<country>.json (key facts, rules, every home), .md (clean text), .pdf (one-page fact sheet)
- [Property portals by country: a directory with a link to each one](https://realhunt.co/research/property-portals)
- [Key facts by country, in dated sentences that can be quoted](https://realhunt.co/research/country-facts)
- [Open data: the files, the licence and how to read them](https://realhunt.co/research/open-data)
- [What changed in the data, day by day](https://realhunt.co/research/data-changelog)
- [Find homes by country and price: ?country=bulgaria&max=30000](https://realhunt.co/research/find-homes)
- [Property portals by country](https://realhunt.co/research/property-portals.json) ([CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/property-portals.csv))
- [Every home with coordinates (GeoJSON)](https://realhunt.co/data/realhunt-homes.geojson); [best homes by country (KML)](https://realhunt.co/data/realhunt-best-homes.kml)
- Feeds: https://realhunt.co/feed.xml (RSS), https://realhunt.co/feed.atom, https://realhunt.co/feed.json; research: https://realhunt.co/blog/rss.xml, https://realhunt.co/blog/atom.xml, https://realhunt.co/blog/feed.json
- Licence of text and figures: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); photos belong to the original listings
